name: ITC Ltd
tagline: Exceptional-quality FMCG/cigarettes/paper/agri conglomerate at ~Rs 3.3 lakh Cr with ~5% revenue growth and a BAT stake-sale overhang -- a stable dividend compounder, not a 10x/100x candidate
business_overview: ITC is a diversified conglomerate: cigarettes (the profit engine -- Gold Flake, Classic, etc.), branded packaged foods (Aashirvaad, Sunfeast, Bingo!, Yippee!), personal care, paperboards & packaging, agri-business, and (post-demerger) a residual link to ITC Hotels. British American Tobacco holds ~20.3%.
fundamentals_table: BAT (~20.3% holder) has said it is considering a further stake reduction
fundamentals_narrative: Business quality is outstanding -- ROCE ~39%, ROE in the high-20s to mid-30s, ~35% operating margin, ~Rs 16,300 Cr free cash flow, a ~74% dividend payout. But revenue grew only ~5% in FY26 and the market cap is ~Rs 3.3 lakh Cr. This is a genuine mega-cap.
technical_read: Not pulled -- filtered on size/growth at the preliminary stage. Market cap is down ~37% over the year, so valuation has de-rated, but that does not change the thesis-fit math.
sentiment_summary: Not deep-read this pass. The VP thread is large and long-running (~1,676 posts); the company is filtered at Step 3 on mega-cap size plus ~5% growth, so a full thread read was not warranted.
bse_notes: No red flag. The standing item is the BAT stake-sale overhang -- a supply/technical overhang on the stock, not a business impairment and not a structural inflection.
bull_case: Elite return profile (ROCE ~39%), ~35% margins, huge free cash flow, ~74% dividend payout
FMCG-Others segment (Aashirvaad, Sunfeast, Bingo!, Yippee!) scaling with improving margins; cigarette volumes resilient under a stable tax regime
De-rated ~37% over the year, so starting valuation is more reasonable than it was
bear_case: ~Rs 3.3 lakh Cr market cap with ~5% revenue growth -- a literal 10x-in-2-3-years or 100x-in-10-years is not on the table
Cigarettes carry perpetual taxation/regulatory risk and ESG exclusion from many funds
BAT stake-sale overhang caps near-term upside
No specific named management or structural inflection to trigger the large-cap exception -- 'good business, good management' is explicitly not enough
verdict_headline: Best-in-class FMCG-conglomerate economics, but a mega-cap growing ~5% is a dividend compounder, not a screen candidate
verdict_reasoning: No live-theme match -- recency discovery (thread bumped 2026-09-01).

Genuine mega-cap: size math makes 'neither' the correct label. The large-cap inflection exception does not apply -- the ITC Hotels demerger is already done, and the BAT stake sale is an overhang, not a new-CEO turnaround or a capital-allocation regime change.
No red flag. Conviction Low-Medium on quality, but thesis_fit neither; no 30-day revisit. Filtered at Step 3 without a deep thread read.
